name: PR Self-Review
description: Three senior self-review passes on the diff before opening PR.
kickoff:
Start the "PR Self-Review" loop.
Goal: three clean self-review passes
Max iterations: 3
Between iterations run: git diff against base branch
Exit when: three passes with no critical findings.
Orientation: read the linked ticket to confirm what the diff must deliver.
Step 1: Review the current diff against ticket acceptance criteria.

loop_contract.name: PR Self-Review
loop_contract.goal: three clean self-review passes on the current diff
loop_contract.exit_when: three passes complete with no critical findings
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics
loop_contract.pacing_notes: Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.
loop_contract.step_1: Review diff like a senior reviewer (requesting-code-review). Note P0–P2 with file refs.

steps.name: Senior review pass
steps.instruction: Review diff like a senior reviewer (requesting-code-review). Note P0–P2 with file refs.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Step 'Senior review pass' completed with evidence.

steps.name: Fix findings
steps.instruction: Address P0/P1 from review. Minimal diffs.

- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof

steps.name: Re-review pass
steps.instruction: Second pass on updated diff. Track pass count toward three clean passes.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
